name: moe_m128_bm32_bn32_v1
hypothesis: Follow up the BM32/BN64 failure with a resource-balanced W2 tile for M128 only. Use BM32, BN32, BK256, and a separate lossless W2 tile-major repack at BN32; this keeps the accumulator element count near the validated BM16xBN64 design while halving rows per W2 weight tile. W13, M32, decode paths, arithmetic, and precision stay unchanged.
decision_reason: All tests passed, but aggregate score regressed from 1.9720839x. Verify-16 rose from 222.9 us to 300.3 us; reject the M128 BM32xBN32 W2 tile and do not integrate into the decoder.
